parameters.name: phone_numbers

parameters.help_en:
The WABA account ID, PageId, or AccountId<props="intl">, or ServiceId</props>.

If the ChannelType parameter is set to WHATSAPP, specify the WABA account ID. View the WABA account ID in Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) > Manage > WABA Management.

If the ChannelType parameter is not set to WHATSAPP, specify the PageId for MESSENGER, the AccountId for INSTAGRAM<props="intl">, or the ServiceId for VIBER</props>
parameters.help_zh:
WABA账号ID/PageId/AccountId<props="intl">/ServiceId</props>。

当ChannelType参数为WHATSAPP时，传WABA账号ID。在通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)>管理>WABA管理界面查看WABA账号ID。

当ChannelType参数非WHATSAPP时，MESSENGER对应传PageId；INSTAGRAM对应传AccountId<props="intl">；VIBER对应传ServiceId</props>
parameters.name: waba_id

parameters.help_en: The flow version. Click the flow name in the Flow Builder (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page to enter the flow builder canvas and view the flow version
parameters.help_zh: 流程版本。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入流程编辑器画布界面查看流程版本
parameters.name: flow_version
